title_zh: 约定隔离会堂入口台阶并检查扶手底座

scenario.label_zh: 会堂入口台阶隔离与扶手底座检查安排
scenario.goal_zh: 讨论加固扶手底座与重建整个入口的可能性，约定先隔离入口台阶再请维修人员检查扶手底座

context_zh: 社区旧会堂的管理员与维修协调员检查入口台阶。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Jamie
sentences.text: The rail moves when I put my hand on it. We should close these steps.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: Yes. We may be able to reinforce the base, but someone needs to inspect it first.

sentences.speaker: Jamie
sentences.text: Do you think we will have to rebuild the whole entrance?

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: I can't tell from here. The other entrance is open, so there is no need to guess.

sentences.speaker: Jamie
sentences.text: I'll secure the temporary barrier across these steps and put up a sign.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: Good. Once that's done, I'll ask our repair team to inspect the base and explain the options.

sentences.speaker: Jamie
sentences.text: Agreed. We won't reopen this entrance until they say it's ready.
